events.from: Parcel trace team, Calloway Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-3377 (TG-9857), two cartons shipped together 29 March. Carton 1 of 2 delivered 31 March. Carton 2 of 2: last scan 30 March, 'held - Vennock hub, internal mailroom, bay M4'. No movement since.

events.to: Parcel trace team, Calloway Arc Logistics
events.body: Please open a trace on carton 2 of 2, DL-3377, last scanned at Vennock hub internal mailroom, bay M4, on 30 March, and arrange its onward movement to the recipient.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Calloway Arc Logistics
events.body: Trace TR-8075 opened on DL-3377 carton 2 of 2. Target 14 days.

Caller: I've rung the carrier three times. First man said it's on a van. A woman on Thursday said it was damaged and going back to the shop. Today someone told me it was never sent as two boxes. I have one box of cot sides in my hall. Which is it? Desk: a trace is open and due by 20 April. Caller: so nobody knows.

events.from: Verity Moorcroft, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the driver told me DL-3377 was handed to someone at the door, so it's been delivered.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Calloway Arc Logistics
events.body: TR-8075 closed automatically: 14 days with no movement scan. Location on record unchanged: Vennock hub, internal mailroom, bay M4. Outcome: none recorded.

events.to: Parcel trace team, Calloway Arc Logistics
events.body: TR-8075 has closed with no outcome and the carton is still recorded in bay M4 at Vennock. Why was it closed without the carton moving, and what gets it out?

events.from: Parcel trace team, Calloway Arc Logistics
events.body: A trace follows scans. An item in a hub's internal mailroom isn't in the parcel flow, so there is nothing for us to follow, and a new trace will time out exactly the same way. Items held off-flow at a hub belong to the Recovery team. They take requests on the Depot work queue with the hub and bay. Nobody here has seen the carton, so we can't tell you why it's in there or whether it still has a label on it.

THREE WEEKS. I HAVE HALF A COT IN MY HALLWAY AND THE OTHER HALF IS IN YOUR OWN POST ROOM. YOU KNOW WHERE IT IS!!! THE TRACE IS 'CLOSED' AND NOTHING MOVED. I AM DUE ON THE 9TH OF MAY. I HAVE BEEN TOLD IT'S ON A VAN, IT'S DAMAGED, IT WAS NEVER TWO BOXES. PLEASE PLEASE JUST SOMEBODY WALK TO THAT ROOM AND PUT IT ON A LORRY. I CAN'T KEEP RINGING.
